name: JUNI chorus
author: hundekraft
description: Made for JUNI, but it works on anything. As the master effect it's stereo, with one delay per side. In I and II the two sides move in opposite directions, which makes it wide; in I+II they move together, as on the original. On a synth or the drums it's mono. The voicing is a Juno-106's, after FM-106 by PatttF and KR-106 by Karl LaRocca.
